method: Arithmetic mean of each team’s available published ordinal ranks; lower is better. All included sources have equal weight. No missing rank is imputed.
tieBreak: Exact mean ties use Bart Torvik rank, then team name. A rounded displayed mean does not determine order.
coverageNote: 364 teams have six source ranks. Idaho State has five because it is not listed in the GrantleyCBB preseason file.
refreshPolicy: Frozen preseason snapshot. The normal daily Salas updater preserves this baseline until enough current-season data is available, then publishes the independent Salas model.

sources.name: KenPom
sources.note: 2027 beginning-of-season ratings; every listed record is 0-0.

sources.name: Bart Torvik
sources.note: 2027 full-team CSV; every listed record is 0-0.

sources.note: 2026-27 public Team Ratings, main rank column with eligibility cases included; every listed record is 0-0.

sources.name: Haslametrics
sources.note: 2026-27 preseason baseline loaded by the public ratings page; every listed record is 0-0. Provider timestamp is a preseason sentinel, so retrieval time is used.

sources.name: CJH Analytics
sources.note: Published 2026-27 baseline proj_rank values from the V3 preseason projection file; no custom interactive eligibility or roster scenarios.

sources.name: GrantleyCBB
sources.note: Season 2027 preseason projections, generated 2026-10-26. Idaho State is absent; its rank is not guessed.
